items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Yeah, she come to the hospital one day.

ctx.x: Did you ever locate Evelyn Carey?
Yeah, she come to the hospital one day. Oh, yeah. So, she sure did. You know where she's at? She gave me her address. Nah, I got it somewhere at home at the house.
Oh, we'll have to find that, man. That's Jack's daughter, I mean.

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: She was a little kid when I lived.

ctx.x: Oh, that's right. I just wanted, I heard some things. I think he just died.

He got a daughter yet, I ain't still a yet. I mean, Evelyn Carey. Evelyn Carey. Yeah, I know she married. I thought she married. I don't know what part of the time she lived in. I sure would like to see her. She was a little kid when I lived.
Who was, who would know? Somebody must have in the band probably kept up with it. Who's still there? Jack Carey.
